objectives.en: Say every fact from nine times one to nine times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti nine times one dé nine times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from nine times one reach nine times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any nine times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí nine times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any nine times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of nine mangoes. Today we count in nines.
say.pcm: Look three groups of nine mango. Today we go count nine nine.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti nine mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní nine nine.

say.en: Today you will learn the nine times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table nine. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table nine. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the eight times table? What is eight times four?
say.pcm: You remember table eight? Eight times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table eight? Kí ni eight times four?

say.en: Three groups of nine mangoes show this. We count nine, eighteen, twenty-seven. Nine times three is twenty-seven.
say.pcm: See three groups of nine mango: nine, eighteen, twenty-seven. Nine times three na twenty-seven.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti nine mango: nine, eighteen, twenty-seven. Nine times three jẹ́ twenty-seven.

say.en: Say it with me: nine times three is twenty-seven.
say.pcm: Say am with me: nine times three na twenty-seven.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: nine times three jẹ́ twenty-seven.

say.en: Say the nine times table. Start with nine times one. End with nine times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table nine. Start with nine times one. End with nine times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table nine. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú nine times one. Parí pẹ̀lú nine times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Nine times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the nine times table once more. Then we start the ten times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table nine again. Then we start table ten.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table nine. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table ten.
